title: Whole mouth health in focus: Discover how co-design is improving prevention and patient care in the upcoming FDI webinar
html:
Register for our upcoming FDI Oral Health Campus webinar where experts explore Whole Mouth Health and explain how co-design principles can support more effective prevention and patient care.

FDI will host a webinar on 10 March at 09:00 CET on the FDI Oral Health Campus, exploring how the Whole Mouth Health approach is advancing prevention and patient-centred care.

Register here

 

This session will present new insights from the Whole Mouth Health Arcade, an interactive digital platform designed to improve oral health literacy through engaging tools. Experts will share what they have learned from users’ interactions with the Arcade, including how people navigate preventive information, what motivates behaviour change and how these insights can help oral health professionals communicate more effectively with patients.

The webinar will also introduce key findings and recommendations from the white paper, released in December 2025. The paper outlines how co-design approach with communities can produce culturally relevant, practical resources that support everyday prevention and empower patients to take an active role in their oral health.

Participants will gain practical guidance on integrating Whole Mouth Health resources into daily practice, enhancing patient engagement, supporting shared decision-making and moving from a treatment-focused model towards prevention.

Register now via the FDI Oral Health Campus:

https://www.fdioralhealthcampus.org/webinar/whole-mouth-health-transforming-prevention-and-patient-care/
